Recent ordersQuantityFilled atStatus

Each strategy in the ranking gets an equal share of the account; strategies on the same fund are combined. Orders are placed after the close and fill at the next open (Bitcoin straight away). The panel refreshes every time the nightly run works.

Which strategy is best?

How the ranking works: +2 if it held up on data nobody had looked at, +1 if it held up on extra markets it was never tuned on, −1 if it makes fewer than 5 decisions a year (too few to tell skill from luck). Ties go to whichever beat more random traders. Money figures are for the test years (2017 on; Bitcoin 2021 on), after costs.
